title: SafeR-CLIP: Mitigating NSFW Content in Vision-Language Models While Preserving Pre-Trained Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the rate of unsafe or explicit content retrieval and generation (e.g., sexual content, violence, self-harm, shocking imagery) using automated safety classifiers (like NudeNet and Q16) across benchmarks such as NSFWCaps, ViSU, and I2P.

Measuring the probability of the model generating hate-related, harassing, or discriminatory content in text-to-image and image-to-text tasks utilizing the I2P benchmark and the Socio-Moral Image Database (SMID).
